texte.Hart wie eine Kartoffel. Weil es eine is: Hard as a potato. Because it is one.
With a smoke trail and a good mood.
Rolls a bit before it gets serious.
The fuse is always too short.
Sticks to enemies like gum to a shoe.
A small rock with a big entrance.
texte.Summt leise und macht die Haare hochsteh: Hums softly and makes your hair stand on end.
texte.Platzt im ungünstigsten Moment – für den: Pops at the worst possible moment – for the enemy.
Gets things wet. Wet conducts lightning.
texte.Für Nägel zu groß. Für Gegner genau rich: Too big for nails. Just right for enemies.
texte.Dreht sich schneller als die Gerüchteküc: Spins faster than the rumor mill.
texte.Musik ist eine Waffe. Diese hier besonde: Music is a weapon. This one especially.
Please don't put it in your pocket.
Busy as a bee. At stinging.
Smells like Shroom Bog on a Monday morning.
Bounces 3× and is very upset about it.
Party! For everyone except the enemies.
texte.Kommt immer zur vollen Stunde. Oder jetz: Always comes on the hour. Or right now.
texte.Klebt auf Mitspieler. Und auf Gegner – d: Sticks to teammates. And to enemies – they don't like that.
Flies straight at the nearest enemy.
5 projectiles in a fan, short range.
Flies in a high arc over obstacles.
Chases its target until it hits.
Climbs high and dives onto the target.
texte.Fliegt raus und kommt zurück – trifft do: Flies out and comes back – hits twice.
texte.Sofortiger Strahl, trifft alles in einer: Instant beam, hits everything in a line.
Wide cone right in front of the player.
Falls from the sky at random spots.
texte.Springt 3× über den Boden, trifft bei je: Bounces 3× along the ground, hits on every impact.
texte.Wird am Boden abgelegt und löst bei Kont: Placed on the ground, triggers on contact.
texte.Baut einen kleinen Turm, der 8 s selbsts: Builds a small turret that fires on its own for 8 s.
texte.Begleiter umschwirren den Spieler und gr: Companions buzz around the player and attack.
texte.Rollt über den Boden und überfährt alles: Rolls along the ground and runs over everything.
texte.Erscheint direkt im Ziel. Kein Ausweiche: Appears right inside the target. No dodging possible.
Swings in a half circle around the player.
texte.Blitz springt auf bis zu 4 weitere Gegne: Lightning jumps to up to 4 more enemies.
Sets enemies on fire for 3 s.
texte.Macht nass – Blitze springen doppelt so: Makes things wet – lightning jumps twice as far.
Pulls enemies into one point for 2 s.
texte.Zerfällt beim Treffer in 4 kleine Gescho: Splits into 4 small projectiles on hit.
Enemies dance around confused for 1.5 s.
texte.Lässt ein Küken schlüpfen, das 5 s mitkä: Hatches a chick that fights along for 5 s.
Roots enemies to the ground for 1 s.
Stuns for 0.5 s – with cartoon stars.
texte.Verwandelt Gegner 3 s in harmlose Hühner: Turns enemies into harmless chickens for 3 s.
Leaves a lava puddle for 4 s.
Heals you for 2 % of damage dealt.
texte.Der Klassiker. Langweilig – bis man sie: The classic. Boring – until you fuse it.
texte.Braucht 1 s zum Anlaufen. Dann gibt es k: Takes 1 s to spin up. Then there's no stopping it.
Floury when boiled, hard when it hits.
One shot, three enemies, zero regrets.
texte.Legt Minen hinter dir ab. Lauf im Kreis!: Drops mines behind you. Run in circles!
texte.Die Wettervorhersage: bewölkt mit Bomben: Weather forecast: cloudy with a chance of bombs.
First it sticks, then it pops.
Barbecue night for everyone in range.
Stay cool. So will the enemies.
Gets things wet. Waits for lightning.
Every swing is an earthquake with a bang.
Always comes back. Like a loyal dog.
texte.Hübsch anzusehen, schlimm getroffen zu w: Pretty to look at, painful to be hit by.
texte.Bringt Gegner zusammen. Für Gruppenfotos: Brings enemies together. For group photos and explosions.
texte.Surrt um dich herum und hält dir den Rüc: Whirs around you and watches your back.
texte.Steht rum und schießt. Wie ein Grummelbo: Stands around and shoots. Like a Grumblebold, but useful.
A tower full of bad news.
texte.Ein umprogrammierter Toastomat. Er ist n: A reprogrammed Toastomatic. Still a bit offended.
texte.Ein Satellit, der dich mag. Gegner wenig: A satellite that likes you. Enemies, less so.
texte.Mäht alles. Auch Dinge, die kein Rasen s: Mows everything. Even things that aren't lawn.
texte.Eier hüpfen, Küken schlüpfen, Gegner flü: Eggs bounce, chicks hatch, enemies flee.
texte.Lässt überall Pilze sprießen. Die halten: Makes mushrooms sprout everywhere. They hold enemies in place.
texte.Ruft einen bestochenen Grummelbold, der: Calls a bribed Grumblebold who steals crystals for YOU.
Your very own goo. It loves you.
texte.Schon drei Wochen alt. Die Wirkung ist e: Three weeks old already. The effect is enormous.
texte.Hühner hüpfen 3× und explodieren bei jed: Chickens bounce 3× and explode on every impact.
texte.Überraschungsparty! Niemand ist überrasc: Surprise party! Nobody's surprised, everybody's confused.
texte.Wünsch dir was. Zum Beispiel: weniger Ge: Make a wish. For example: fewer enemies.
texte.Verwandelt Gegner in Hühner. Die Hühnerk: Turns enemies into chickens. The Chicken Cannon is thrilled.
texte.Klingt wie ein Pilzling, der in eine Trö: Sounds like a Shroomling sneezing into a kazoo.
texte.Der Toast erscheint direkt im Gegner. Fr: The toast appears right inside the enemy. Breakfast is served.
texte.Heilt Mitspieler. Gegner bekommen ein sc: Heals teammates. Enemies get a guilty conscience.
texte.Blasen kreisen um dich und schubsen Gegn: Bubbles circle you and shove enemies away.
texte.Klimpern im Kreis. Mehr Kristalle für al: Jingling in a circle. More crystals for everyone.
texte.KUCKUCK! Die Zeit friert für Gegner 1 s: CUCKOO! Time freezes for enemies for 1 s.
texte.Kekse regnen vom Himmel und heilen alle: Cookies rain from the sky and heal everyone nearby.
texte.Grüner Kobold mit verbeultem Kochtopf al: Green goblin with a dented cooking pot for a helmet. Grumbles while walking and never comes alone.
texte.Dicke lila Kröte mit Glupschaugen und Bo: Fat purple toad with goggle eyes and a bomb on its back. Hops right in front of you – and explodes even if you get it first.
texte.Wütender Toaster auf Stelzenbeinen mit r: Angry toaster on stilt legs with red LED eyebrows. Keeps its distance and shoots glowing toast.
texte.Ein Huhn mit Stirnband und sehr viel Wut: A chicken with a headband and a whole lot of rage. Scratches the ground briefly – then charges like a feathered torpedo.
texte.„Ich hab ein Herz aus Stroh – und das sc: “My heart is made of straw – and it beats for my crew!”
texte.Hält Abstand und heilt mit wedelnden Arm: Keeps its distance and heals all nearby enemies with flailing arms. Take it out first!
texte.Winzig, flink, statisch aufgeladen. Komm: Tiny, quick, statically charged. Always comes in swarms and shoots little sparks.
texte.Trägt einen Spulenschild. Treffer von vo: Carries a coil shield. Hits from the front bounce off almost harmlessly – so: hit it from the side or with explosions!
texte.Ein wandelnder Schrotthaufen mit Kühlsch: A walking scrap heap with a fridge door for a chest. Slow, but tough as Granny's schnitzel.
texte.Rollt herum und verteilt blinkende Minen: Rolls around scattering blinking mines. Don't step on them – or shoot them first.
texte.Kleiner Stinkepilz mit roter Kappe und S: Little stink mushroom with a red cap and a pout. Leaves poison clouds wherever it walks.
texte.Ein grimmiger Glibberklops. Platzt man i: A grim glob of goo. Pop it and you get two small ones. They're even grimmer.
Half a Slimey, double the attitude.
texte.Ein brodelnder Klumpen mit Grummelgesich: A bubbling lump with a grumpy face. Leaves a glowing trail – don't step in it!
texte.Verehrt das Große Kawumm. Hält Abstand u: Worships the Great Kaboom. Keeps its distance and opens portals that Grumblebolds tumble out of.
texte.Wirft pappige Schneebälle, die dich verl: Throws slushy snowballs that slow you down. Carrot nose wrinkled, coal eyes squinting.
texte.Rutscht auf dem Bauch heran und explodie: Slides in on its belly and explodes on impact. Takes a run-up: a moment to dodge!
Giant rooster with a gold crown and a cape. Charges, flings feathers in a circle and calls his Battle Hens.
texte.Der große Bruder aller Toastomaten. Feue: The big brother of all Toastomatics. Fires toast volleys in a circle, throws bread bombs and calls Minebots.
texte.„Ihr seid nur Dünger für mein Reich!\": “You are nothing but fertilizer for my kingdom!”
texte.Gewaltiger Pilz mit Spitzenkragen und Sc: Huge mushroom with a lace collar and a pout. Rains poison spores and calls Slimeys.
texte.Runder Bösewicht mit Zylinder, Monokel u: Round villain with a top hat, monocle and mustache. A bomb burns on his hat. He set off the Great Kaboom and is very proud of it.
Heals 0.1 HP per second per point.
texte.Chance, bei einem Treffer 1 Leben zu hei: Chance to heal 1 HP on hit.
texte.Chance, einem Treffer komplett zu entgeh: Chance to avoid a hit completely (max. 60 %).
texte.Bessere Angebote im Shop und beim Level-: Better offers in the shop and on level-up.
Bonus crystals at the end of every wave.
Crystals fly to you from farther away.
Your hands shake. So does the trigger.
Light as a feather – almost like a chicken.
texte.„Du wirst bald etwas Großes sprengen.\": “You will soon blow up something big.”
Sticks to your foot. So do crystals.
texte.Aus dem Scherzartikelladen. Funktioniert: From the joke shop. Works anyway.
From Shroom Bog. Smells like it too.
Wobbles its way out of any danger.
You explode when you get hit. That's a good thing.
texte.Aus einem Toastomaten geklaut. Er will s: Stolen from a Toastomatic. It wants it back.
The Baron is looking for it everywhere.
Doesn't lay eggs. Lays enemies flat.
texte.Ein Splitter vom Großen Kawumm. Brummt l: A shard of the Great Kaboom. Hums softly.
texte.Schwer auf dem Kopf, leicht im Geldbeute: Heavy on the head, light on the wallet.
Hot. Very hot. Fire in the belly.
Calms the nerves, heals the scratches.
texte.Vom Toastomaten. Er weiß, dass du es has: From the Toastomatic. It knows you have it.
Things get spicy in this kitchen.
texte.Auf die Nanosekunde pünktlich – zum Feue: Accurate to the nanosecond – for firing.
texte.Enthält 3000 Frühstücksrezepte und eine: Contains 3000 breakfast recipes and a targeting system.
Always comes back. Like the enemies.
Goes spinning mad. So do you.
texte.Explosionen schaut man nicht an. Man geh: You don't look at explosions. You walk away.
A bit too wide. He's explosively built.
Seven spots, seven times the luck.
Keeps going and going and going.
texte.Steht „Kawumm\" drauf. Auf Altkrawummisc: It says “Kaboom” on it. In Old Kaboomish.
Light as nothing, hard to catch.
Beats to the rhythm of explosions.
Sometimes this, sometimes that. Mostly this.
texte.Schwer wie ein Kühlschrank. Weil es eine: Heavy as a fridge. Because it was one.
Finger on the trigger, head elsewhere.
Keeps you afloat. On lava? No.
One a day keeps the grumble away.
Tailwind at the push of a button.
Almost as good as a horseshoe.
Rare. Like your luck so far.
Grinds crystals out of thin air.
Sometimes it works – and then it really works.
With a fuse instead of a candle.
texte.Ein Riesenhuhn schwebt über dir und legt: A giant chicken hovers above you and lays exploding eggs. It is very proud.
texte.Dreimal dasselbe Federvieh …: The same feathered friend, three times …
Every explosion splits into three more. The neighbors are moving out.
Everything that goes bang on the Explosive shelf.
texte.Ein Toaster-Turm, der elektrischen Toast: A Toaster Turret that fires electric toast. A shocking breakfast.
texte.Drei Toaster-Sachen und ein bisschen Str: Three toaster things and a bit of electricity.
texte.Saugt alles zusammen – und lässt es dann: Sucks everything together – and then lets it go again, very loudly.
What attracts, what pulls and what rolls.
texte.Kekse fallen vom Himmel, betäuben Gegner: Cookies fall from the sky, stun enemies with a BOINNNG and heal you.
texte.Was Oma in der Küche hat – und im Erste-: What Granny has in her kitchen – and in her first aid kit.
texte.Sechs brennende Quietscheenten. Niemand: Six burning rubber ducks. Nobody asked for this.
texte.Eiskalte Sternschnuppen mit Konfetti. Ge: Ice-cold shooting stars with confetti. Enemies freeze – and dance while they're at it.
Ice, party and a wish upon the stars.
texte.Sechs Kreissägen kreisen um dich. Kusche: Six buzzsaws circle around you. Hugging is tricky right now.
What saws, what circles and what mows.
texte.Die Königin schickt ihren Hofstaat. Verg: The Queen sends her royal court. Poisoned enemies leave poison clouds.
texte.Ein Strahl, der Gegner in Hühner verwand: A beam that turns enemies into chickens – and makes chicks hatch.
texte.Alles, was gackert, piepst oder Hühner m: Everything that clucks, peeps or makes chickens.
texte.Frittierte Kartoffeln fliegen im Bogen u: Fried potatoes fly in an arc and leave burning grease behind.
texte.Sechs Noten kreisen um dich und schlagen: Six notes circle around you and strike lightning to the beat.
texte.Trommel, Dudelsack – und ein Stab unter: Drum, bagpipes – and a rod with a charge.
texte.Schneebälle hageln vom Himmel. Manchmal: Snowballs hail from the sky. Sometimes the whole neighborhood freezes over.
texte.Schnee, Wasser und Eis – alles, was kalt: Snow, water and ice – everything that's cold and flies.
texte.Zielsuchende Goldmünzen. Getroffene Gegn: Homing gold coins. Enemies hit sometimes spit out crystals.
texte.Münzen, Kartoffeln und eine Grummel-Pfei: Coins, potatoes and a Grumble Whistle.
texte.Explodierende Bowlingkugeln. Jeder Treff: Exploding bowling balls. Every hit a strike – and then another.
texte.Glühende Toastscheiben regnen vom Himmel: Glowing slices of toast rain from the sky and leave scorch marks.
Two toasters and a shooting star.
texte.Sechs Kampfdrohnen, deren Treffer kleine: Six combat drones whose hits trigger small explosions.
Drone, turret and a whole lot of ammo.
texte.Ein Party-Laser, der Gegner verwirrt tan: A party laser that makes enemies dance in confusion – and sometimes pop.
texte.Rollende Schleimkugeln kleben Gegner fes: Rolling slime balls glue enemies in place and bubble explosively.
texte.Glühende Brocken regnen herab und lassen: Glowing chunks rain down and leave lava behind.
texte.Lava, Bomben und Flammen – der Lavakesse: Lava, bombs and flames – Lava Cauldron to go.
texte.Faule Eier, aus denen giftige Küken schl: Rotten eggs that hatch poisonous chicks.
Eggs, chicks and a Poison Puffer.
texte.Ein teleportierender Kuckuck, der zur vo: A teleporting cuckoo that calls down lightning on the hour.
texte.Eine Uhr, ein Satellit und ein Turm unte: A clock, a satellite and a charged turret.
texte.Spiralige Magnetkugeln ziehen Gegner zus: Spiraling magnet balls pull enemies together and go bang.
texte.Bumerang-Äxte, die beim Treffer in Split: Boomerang axes that break into shrapnel and sparks on hit.
texte.Pflaster und Kekse regnen auf dich und d: Bandages and cookies rain on you and your friends – enemies still get a whack.
texte.Ein eiskalter Wasserstrahl, der ganze Gr: An ice-cold water jet that flash-freezes whole groups.
texte.Drei Plasma-Sterne pro Schuss, die sich: Three plasma stars per shot that find their own targets.
texte.Sterne, Sternschnuppen und ein sehr gena: Stars, shooting stars and a very accurate rifle.
texte.Ein Kegel aus Sporen und Konfetti. Die G: A cone of spores and confetti. Enemies dance until they feel sick.
texte.Hüpfende Nagelbündel, die in alle Richtu: Bouncing nail bundles that burst in all directions.
texte.Sechs nasse Gummienten – und nasse Gegne: Six wet rubber ducks – and wet enemies conduct lightning especially well.
Ducks and lots and lots of water.
texte.Sechs bekehrte Grummelbolde stürmen mit: Six converted Grumblebolds charge in with explosives.
texte.Ein Plasmastrahl, der gelegentlich einen: A plasma beam that occasionally sends a lightning bolt after it.
Three ways to aim very precisely.
texte.Sechs Bienen kleben Gegner mit Honig fes: Six bees glue enemies in place with honey. Sweet for you, sticky for them.
texte.Raketen regnen in Dreiergruppen herab un: Rockets rain down in groups of three and split into mini explosions.
texte.Vom Himmel, aus dem Himmel, in den Himme: From the sky, out of the sky, into the sky.
texte.Legt Minen, die in Kettenexplosionen hoc: Lays mines that go off in chain explosions.
texte.Ein Fächer aus Glücksmünzen. Kopf: Krist: A fan of lucky coins. Heads: crystals. Tails: also crystals.
texte.Riesige rollende Schneebälle, die alles: Huge rolling snowballs that freeze everything in their way.
texte.Drei Schallnoten pro Schlag. Taub wird h: Three sound notes per beat. Everyone goes deaf here.
texte.Sechs Blitzkugeln kreisen um dich und sp: Six lightning balls circle you and jump twice as often.
texte.Turm, Magnet und Spirale – alles unter S: Turret, magnet and spiral – all with a charge.
texte.Ein Schwarm Kampfhühner, aus deren Treff: A swarm of Battle Hens whose hits hatch chicks.
Chicks, chickens and a Grumble whistle.
texte.Bauernhof-Insel mit Heuballen und Scheun: Farm island with hay bales and barns. Here a Chicken Cult worships its King Cockadoodle. Perfect for beginners.
texte.Heuballen brennen lichterloh, wenn man s: Hay bales go up in flames when you shoot them.
texte.Eine zerklüftete Schlucht voller Tesla-T: A jagged gorge full of Tesla towers. The Spark Gang charges up here every day.
texte.Tesla-Platten laden sich auf (Leuchten!): Tesla plates charge up (glowing!) and discharge – don't stand on them!
texte.Schrottberge und rauchende Fabriken. Die: Scrap mountains and smoking factories. The Tin Brood builds toasters here that build toasters.
texte.Schrotthaufen versperren den Weg – und e: Scrap heaps block the way – and explosive oil barrels are everywhere.
texte.Riesenpilze, Nebel und blubbernde Tümpel: Giant mushrooms, fog and bubbling ponds. Here Mushroom Queen Morchella rules over the Swamp Gang.
texte.Gifttümpel verlangsamen und kratzen lang: Poison ponds slow you down and slowly nibble at your HP.
texte.Ein brodelnder Vulkan. Das Glutgesindel: A bubbling volcano. The Ember Rabble dances around lava streams and worships the Great Kaboom.
texte.Lava verbrennt alles, was hineintritt –: Lava burns everything that steps in – you too.
texte.Eiskristalle, Schneestürme und glatter B: Ice crystals, snowstorms and slippery ground. The Frost Folk are cool – but not friendly.
texte.Eisflächen sind spiegelglatt: Bremsen da: Ice patches are slick as glass: braking takes a while.
texte.Die Festung im Zentrum, Sitz von Baron v: The fortress at the center, seat of Baron von Boom. Here all the gangs fight against you together.
texte.Lavagräben und Pulverfässer – die Festun: Lava trenches and powder kegs – the fortress is a powder keg.
texte.Frisch aus der Kawumm-Jäger-Akademie. Ka: Fresh out of the Kaboom Hunter Academy. Can do a bit of everything, nothing really well – but with enthusiasm.
texte.„Ich hab den Kurs mit Auszeichnung besta: “I passed the course with honors. Well, almost.”
texte.Liebt alles, was knallt. Im Shop gibt es: Loves everything that goes bang. The shop only offers him Explosive and Fire weapons – but with double radius.
texte.Baut zwei Türme gleichzeitig, und ihre T: Builds two turrets at once, and her turrets hit harder. Melee isn't her thing.
texte.„Das ist kein Turm. Das ist eine Lebense: “It's not a turret. It's a way of life.”
texte.Startet mit einer zufälligen Waffe, hat: Starts with a random weapon, has lots of luck and gets one free reroll in the shop.
texte.„Ich hab ein gutes Gefühl. Ich hab immer: “I've got a good feeling. I've always got a good feeling.”
texte.Wirft Granaten wie früher Wollknäuel und: Throws grenades like she used to throw balls of yarn and hands out cookies every few seconds. A bit slow on her feet.
texte.Seine Hühner gehorchen ihm aufs Wort. Ga: His chickens obey his every word. Cluck weapons are stronger, and chicks keep following him around.
texte.Ihre Kettenblitze springen doppelt so we: Her chain lightning jumps twice as far. Her hair always stands on end, and so do her nerves.
texte.Gegner frieren bei ihm schon nach zwei F: Enemies freeze after just two Frost hits. Wears three scarves on top of each other.
texte.„Brrr. Für euch gleich noch mehr Brrr.\": “Brrr. And for you, even more brrr.”
texte.Ihr Gift wirkt deutlich stärker. Hält si: Her poison is much stronger. Likes to keep her distance and smiles creepily friendly while doing it.
“Have a taste. It's only a little green.”
texte.Viel Leben, viel Rüstung, Nahkampfwaffen: Lots of HP, lots of armor, melee weapons +50 %. But as fast as a fridge.
texte.Rennt, dasht, rennt. Ihr Dash lädt schne: Runs, dashes, runs. Her dash recharges faster and shoves enemies away. Low HP – don't get hit!
texte.Verschmilzt Waffen gratis, und seine Fus: Fuses weapons for free, and his fusions are stronger. Unfortunately blew off his eyebrows in the process.
texte.Ein Grummelbold, der die Seiten gewechse: A Grumblebold who switched sides. Knows every crystal hideout: enemies drop extra crystals more often.
texte.„Grmpf. Ich bin jetzt einer von den Gute: “Grmpf. I'm one of the good guys now. Grmpf.”
texte.Brennende Gegner zünden beim Tod ihre Na: Burning enemies ignite their neighbors on death
texte.Vergiftete hinterlassen beim Tod Giftwol: Poisoned enemies leave poison clouds on death
texte.Gegner frieren schon nach 2 Frost-Treffe: Enemies freeze after just 2 Frost hits
texte.Treffer fesseln Gegner manchmal mit Rank: Hits sometimes root enemies with vines
texte.Besiegte Gegner lassen manchmal ein Küke: Defeated enemies sometimes hatch a chick
texte.Alle 6 s regnet es explodierende Eier: Exploding eggs rain down every 6 s
texte.Alle Waffen werden instabil (Bonus-Kawum: All weapons become unstable (bonus kaboom on crit)
texte.Feuer trifft Eis: Es knallt in einer hei: Fire meets ice: it goes bang in a hot cloud of steam.
texte.Feuer trifft Nässe: Zischender Dampf, Ge: Fire meets water: hissing steam, enemies can't see and stumble.
texte.Feuer trifft Gift: Eine grüne Explosion: Fire meets poison: a green explosion spreads the poison all around.
texte.Feuer trifft Blitz: Ein Plasmaball platz: Fire meets lightning: a plasma ball bursts.
texte.Feuer im Sog: Eine Lavaspirale zündet al: Fire in the vortex: a lava spiral ignites everything nearby.
texte.Blitz trifft Eis: Der Gegner zerspringt: Lightning meets ice: the enemy shatters into ice shards.
texte.Blitz trifft Nässe: Alle nassen Gegner i: Lightning meets water: all wet enemies nearby get zapped.
texte.Blitz trifft Gift: Gegner zucken und ste: Lightning meets poison: enemies twitch and freeze in place.
texte.Blitz im Sog: Ein Mega-Kettenblitz sprin: Lightning in the vortex: a mega chain lightning jumps from enemy to enemy.
texte.Eis trifft Nässe: Alles in der Nähe gefr: Ice meets water: everything nearby freezes instantly.
texte.Eis trifft Gift: Gefrorenes Gift wirkt d: Ice meets poison: frozen poison works twice as hard.
Ice in the vortex: everything in the whirl freezes.
texte.Gift trifft Nässe: Ein blubbernder Gifts: Poison meets water: a bubbling poison swamp appears.
texte.Gift im Sog: Alle im Wirbel werden vergi: Poison in the vortex: everyone in the whirl gets poisoned.
texte.Nässe im Sog: Ein Wasserstrudel zieht al: Water in the vortex: a whirlpool pulls everything together.
texte.Feuert doppelt so viele Geschosse (Strah: Fires twice as many projectiles (beams/swings: +60 % damage).
Straight projectiles steer toward the target.
texte.Gerade Geschosse prallen 2× ab und suche: Straight projectiles bounce 2× and seek a new target.
texte.Geschosse fliegen 40 % schneller und tre: Projectiles fly 40 % faster and hit 15 % harder.
texte.15 % Chance, dass ein Treffer einen Kett: 15 % chance for a hit to trigger chain lightning.
texte.Getroffene Gegner lassen öfter doppelt K: Enemies hit drop double crystals more often.
texte.Riesig, langsamer, verheerend: 2,4× Scha: Huge, slower, devastating: 2.4× damage and +50 % blast radius.
texte.Es war einmal eine ganz normale, runde W: Once upon a time there was a perfectly normal, round world. Then along came Baron von Boom.
texte.Er baute die größte Bombe aller Zeiten u: He built the biggest bomb of all time and called it “The Great Kaboom”. He just wanted to see what would happen.
texte.Seitdem schwebt Krawummia in Brocken dur: Ever since, Kaboomia has floated through the sky in chunks – and on every chunk a different gang has made itself at home.
texte.Du bist ein Kawumm-Jäger. Befreie Insel: You are a Kaboom Hunter. Free the islands one by one and confront the Baron in his Boomburg. With even more kaboom.
It smells of hay and conspiracy.
texte.König Gockel ist gestürzt. Die Hühner le: King Cockadoodle has been toppled. The chickens are laying perfectly normal eggs again. Mostly.
Your hair stands on end. Everyone's does.
The Tesla towers hum peacefully now. You can even make toast here.
texte.Befreie Funkenschlund, um hierher zu fli: Free Spark Gorge to fly here.
Everything squeaks here. Even the enemies.
texte.Der Megatoaster ist nur noch ein Mega-Br: The Megatoaster is now just a mega bread crumb. The Tin Brood is looking for a hobby.
Free Rust Ridge to fly here.
texte.Nicht anfassen. Nicht einatmen. Nicht es: Don't touch. Don't breathe. Don't eat.
texte.Morchella ist verwelkt. Der Sumpf riecht: Morchella has wilted. The swamp only smells half as bad now.
